messages:
maya: quick heads up — I opened a docs PR to clarify how adapter-enabled model variants interact with quantized fallback variants in the catalog. mainly wording + a small SDK example. https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/4123 :wave:
ravi: thanks — link? going to skim now. is this about `+adapter` syntax vs pinned variant names? :thinking_face:
maya: yup. goal is to explain: 1) what happens if runtime receives model `nebula3b+adapter:romulan-v1` but only `nebula3b-int8` is available on some capacity tiers, 2) how seq length and kv-cache behavior change, and 3) recommended snippet for SDK usage + fallback policy config.
samir: nice. do we have benchmark numbers to justify recommending `int8` fallback for latency-sensitive endpoints?
maya: added a short table in the PR: median p95 token latency (single-request) for nebula3b vs nebula3b-int8 vs nebula3b+adapter on g4dn. numbers are very rough from last week:  nebula3b: p95 220ms, nebula3b-int8: p95 185ms, nebula3b+adapter (merged runtime) p95 240ms. included note that adapters add ~10-20% decode overhead.
olivia: can you add a short callout about quality expectations when falling back to quantized base variant? folks often expect identical outputs.
maya: good point. I added: "Quantized fallback will usually preserve semantics but may change tokenization and subtle probabilities; include a small eval prompt set and set `quality_monitoring: true` in the route to detect regressions."
ravi: the SDK snippet looks fine but we should show `fallback_policy` config and an example route JSON. also mention `max_total_tokens` changes because KV checkpointing is disabled for adapter-only paths on some kernels.
maya: added route example:```json
{
  "model": "nebula3b+adapter:romulan-v1",
  "fallback_policy": ["nebula3b-int8","nebula3b"],
  "max_total_tokens": 4096,
  "note": "runtime may lower effective context if adapter-only kernels require different KV layout"
}
```
samir: would be good to include a short CLI example for engineers doing quick smoke tests.
maya: added CLI snippet: `rwctl infer --model nebula3b+adapter:romulan-v1 --input "Summarize this" --max-tokens 128 --prefer-quant-fallback`

olivia: I left inline comments about tone + added a short blurb in the model card: "Adapters supported via `+adapter` suffix; fallback to compatible quantized variants is automatic per routing policy." small nit: mention that adapter variants are not currently supported on Private on-prem older runtime < v1.8.
maya: noted — I added a compatibility note and flagged it for the release notes section.
docs-ci-bot: PR 4123 docs build: success ✅ — preview deployed at https://docs-preview.company/4123
ravi: quick editorial: change `will usually preserve semantics` -> `generally preserves intent but may alter phrasing` (less absolute).
maya: done. pushed.

olivia: last ask — can we add a short sample eval prompt (3 prompts) to the PR under `examples/adapter-evals.md` so QE can run regression checks?
maya: adding now. small list: 1) instruction to summarize a 6-paragraph doc, 2) translate marketing headline to french, 3) multi-turn followup requiring memory of entity.
samir: once QE gives a thumbs up, we can merge. Feels like low-risk doc change. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — I'll ping QE and link the PR in release notes. merging after QE signoff. :shipit:
